dog.description_text:
Since I'm a long stay pup, my adoption fee has been reduced! Visit me today to find out my favorite treats and how you can take me home!

My foster writes: Monet is just an angel. He is the perfect gentleman at home--crate trained, potty trained, and an excellent listener, he is such an easygoing dog. He loves to cuddle up next to you on the couch, or chill in his crate and watch you do errands around the house. And because he is comfortable being alone for up to six hours, he's the perfect companion for anyone who likes to both chill at home and go to the office/social events. He doesn't beg for food, chew your things, or bark/whine excessively--all he does is give you love and sweetness! Anyone would be lucky to have this gentle sweetheart in their lives!!

My foster writes: Meet Monet! A loving, playful, silly, energetic 8 year old male. He is potty trained, crate trained, knows tricks, and is a very good listener. He loves his tug toys, playing fetch, is extremely treat driven, and a very good listener. Whether you are looking for someone to cuddle with on the couch or burn some energy with, Monet loves it all! He really is the best dog!

My foster writes: Monet is a joyful, cuddle‑powered sweetheart who loves nothing more than showing off his snuggling skills to anyone willing to receive them. He greets his people with an adorable prance, carries his toys over for gentle tug‑of‑war, and takes treats with the softest mouth. Monet learns quickly, adapts easily, and is eager to please, making him a great fit for many types of homes. On walks he may pull or get excited when he sees other dogs, but his enthusiasm is all wiggles - never teeth, growls, or snaps. If you're looking for a loving, loyal companion with endless charm, Monet is ready to brighten your life.

Another foster writes:
I started off with Monet as a Straycation and quickly realized I would try long-term fostering him as my first foster because of how well behaved he is and of course he has the cutest face !!! I began fostering Monet, who is 8 years old, since 7/21/26 so far and he is the sweetest, happiest boy who is always excited to greet me with wiggles when I return from work. He is a quick learner, adapts easily, and has nothing but love and sweetness to give. Monet is house-trained, crate-trained, and enjoys going for walks. Monet is able to walk on a slacked leash, although he does pull on the leash - he is able to be redirected; moreover, he allows me to clean his paws after walks. He enjoys playing tug-of-war, followed up by fetch. Monet will try bringing a toy/ball to you to get you involved when he's feeling playful. He LOVES treats and will take them with the softest mouth. He is truly easy to love!
dog.name: Monet
